screenshotStyleReason: The text box band is fixed over the conversation on both sides, so it is hidden only while answers are shot, as are each side's header and its floating Composer button.
mockInitReason: The trip under way is the one the mock's Travel writes when “I’m on my way” is tapped at 13:10 (departures-next/?scenario=scheduled, .next-trip-go: the sample's 13:14), set before the page loads; the app's is MockSample\TravelSeeder's MOCK_TRIP=started, the same 13:14 started at 13:10. The mock's sample-only bar stays hidden, and its two sample phrases (“Scheduled sample times”, “This preview has no live times”) read as the app says them, as in composer-answers-trip.json.
yReason: While a trip is under way both pages show Travel's on-your-way bar above Composer (components/travel/on-your-way-bar.tsx, session 3's): the mock's sits in the page's flow, the app's lies over the heading, so the conversation starts 8px apart. Raised with session 3; the answers are compared where they stand.
